description:
Well-defined intra axial lesion of heterogeneous attenuation with internal coarse calcifications located in right anterior frontal lobe in predominantly cortical-subcortical location with perilesional edema.

The remainder of the brain is unremarkable in appearance. Ventricles are within normal limits in size. No focal osseous lesion.
